holdings.scope: personal estates and holdings; Round 107 adds a six-acre adjoining strip for 9 denarii

continuity.campaign_development: The election opened on 26 January 57 BCE; Valerius remains an active candidate and an administrative ballot-record dispute was contained without a published result.
continuity.commercial_thread: Round 118 recurring settlement realized 54 gross / 23 costs / 31 net; 3.1 private / 27.9 public.
continuity.road_thread: Shared-water road remains open and toll-free; no new road event surfaced this round.
continuity.road_investigation: Completed and classified; remains background canon.
continuity.election_thread: The election is now in its active voting period; no numerical tally, appointment, endorsement, or final result has been recorded.
continuity.refuge_policy: The second displaced household is now formally registered as a regular tenant on existing estate land; population remains 257.
continuity.personal_guard: 414 soldiers remain available overall; personal guard remains 100 with 50 infantry and 50 cavalry.
continuity.silver_development_thread: Second silver working completed another commercial sale at 22 gross / 8 costs / 14 net; deeper reserve remains unresolved.
continuity.family_thread: The documentary conflict was resolved as an old draft copied without its final cancellation mark; no land transfer, payment, or new encumbrance occurred.
continuity.urban_estate_thread: Open-access facility policy remains in force; ordinary merchant use has now produced a concrete cost-recovery transaction.
continuity.merchant_access_thread: Expanded merchant access now includes the new capitalization network; a lake-port merchant house completed an unexpected bulk artisan order.
continuity.library_thread: The technical measurement method tested in Round 117 became a formal working standard for selected estate commercial lots.
continuity.trade_capitalization_directive: Standing from Round 118: commercially convert saleable surplus and appropriate needed inputs into realized capital through the principal estate, established merchant services, lake port, and skilled artisan network; realized transactions only, with no speculative future receipts.
continuity.trade_capitalization_thread: Round 118 first capitalization cycle realized 68 gross / 27 costs / 41 net; lake-port artisan bulk order realized 35 gross / 12 costs / 23 net.
continuity.six_acre_parcel_thread: Six-acre parcel suffered winter waterlogging and received a 5-denarii drainage repair; no acreage changed and future yield remains unresolved.

special_event_policy.rule: Special is a core event category; every round performs an independent Special roll. Successful Magnitude-11 checks independently generate Special events; Ultimate remains a separate post-generation classification gate.

end_of_round_checks.ultimate_gate: PASS — E01 and E05 remain Surprise

financial_realization.note: Positive realized event profits: 41, 31, 23, and 14 denarii; 10% event-level routing produces 4.1, 3.1, 2.3, and 1.4 denarii privately (10.9 total). A separate 5-denarii repair expense reduces public account only. Net round public effect is 104 - 10.9 = 93.1 denarii.

next_round_gate.requirements: Round 118 persistence, mathematical reconciliation, and post-commit verification passed.

round_94_correction.reason: Round 94 battle corrected: no member of Valerius's force is permanently lost; five wounded remain temporarily unavailable.

valerius_equipment.material_source: Valerius personal mines and estate stores
valerius_equipment.craftsmen: finest smiths of the estate and foundries
valerius_equipment.shield: new personal shield; exceptionally intricate and structurally tough; deliberately more intricate than Valerius's weapons as a symbol of devotion to protection and defense
valerius_equipment.gladius: personal high-quality Roman gladius; reputation linked to Valerius's established combat record
valerius_equipment.pilum: double-reinforced personal pilum; carries Valerius's oath to march at the head of every battle and personally participate
valerius_equipment.shield_piercing_record: individual truthful record for every confirmed shield personally pierced; no unverified encounter is added
valerius_equipment.kill_record: open truthful combat ledger; future confirmed individual kills may be recorded, but no unsupported kill count is asserted

chapter.title: THE SECOND CHAPTER
chapter.generation_model: simulate broadly -> allow background development -> detect material developments -> consolidate each causal chain into one event -> output significant news only
chapter.background_activity_policy: Established sources continue to change state silently; only significant developments become player-facing events.
chapter.ai_ledger_policy: Every event ledger distinguishes event-caused changes from background-source changes and names each background source specifically; background changes are not attributed to the event itself.

round_history.directive: No new player directive; continue simulation from the verified Round 115 state.

The election begins; Valerius formally grants the new tenants regular tenant status; expand trade so surplus and needed items are commercially converted into capital through the established merchant network, lake port, principal estate, and skilled artisan network.

silver_development_thread: Second silver working completed its first commercial sale at 16 gross / 6 costs / 10 net; eventual yield remains unresolved.
